findings.title: (محدث ثانِ) ارتفاع حصيلة انهيار جرف رملي على خيام نازحين في دير البلح إلى 4 شهداء
findings.title_english: Updated: Four reported killed, including three children, after sandy embankment collapses onto displaced families' tents in Deir al-Balah
findings.location: Ard al-Ribat displacement camp, Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population: WAFA Arabic second update reports four fatalities (one woman and three children), five injured rescued alive, with search for missing continuing. A separate Safa report claims five fatalities and six injured; the figures are disputed and must not be summed.
findings.affected_system: Displaced civilians and makeshift shelter safety; sandy cliff/embankment collapse onto tents amid heavy rain and unstable ground
findings.exact_supporting_passage: إلى أربعة شهداء، بينهم امرأة وثلاثة أطفال
findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency quoting medical sources and rescue crews; local reporter on the same incident from Safa provides a differing count

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct WAFA Arabic homepage and WAFA English latest-news feed, clicked exact article after OCHA OPT and WHO official first checks and bounded targeted search; found supplementary Arabic report via targeted search.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: The prior heartbeat did not contain this specific Deir al-Balah cliff collapse or casualties. WAFA Arabic second update timestamp 20:57 Jerusalem time (10:57 PST) and WAFA English 21:17 local (11:17 PST), both after the prior verified completion at about 10:51 PST.
bounded_discovery_context.temporal_limit: The exact cliff-collapse time was not supplied; 'Sunday evening' is the source's stated incident period. Publication time is not represented as incident time.
bounded_discovery_context.primary_report: WAFA Arabic second update: one woman and three children died and five living injured people were pulled out; crews continued searching for missing people.
bounded_discovery_context.alternate_report: Safa's 21:00 Jerusalem-time article asserts five people killed including three children, six injured; WAFA's official Arabic second update reports four killed and five injured; English WAFA initial report records two deaths and five injured. Different counts concern the same incident. Do not treat any count as independently settled.
bounded_discovery_context.nonduplication: Separate new direct-casualty event from earlier storm reports and quantified shelter/flooding risks, and from the earlier two killed in a Khan Younis drone strike. Do not combine incident fatality counts with weather cumulative losses.
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: Both WAFA and Safa report a collapse at displaced people's tents in Deir al-Balah, but counts diverge. No OCHA/WHO/PRCS independent incident verification located in this bounded run.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall watch, not Gaza production publisher or collector; no approval, publication, credential, permission, task or schedule changes.

direct_publisher_checks.result: Direct homepage led to 20:57 local second update on fatal Deir al-Balah sand-cliff collapse; confirms first-hand attributed fatalities and injured, but exact incident time unavailable.
21:17 local English story describes same incident using older figure of two deaths and five injured. Do not double count.
Flooding pieces and aid appeals did not verify additional distinct in-window developments.
Latest homepage bulletin remains November 3; no newly verified medical-evacuation or ambulance bulletin.
Reporter describes same cliff-collapse but counts five deaths and six injured; discrepancy logged without treating this as a second event or settled casualty count.
Recurring access restriction, no newly material deterioration.

exclusions: Prior two killed in Taiba Towers Khan Younis drone strike already recorded in 07:44 heartbeat; excluded from new count.
Earlier Khan Younis woman shot and Bir al-Naaja/Jabalia four additional injured previously handed off; excluded.
Earlier flooding, 270 at-risk camps, 20% drainage operation, 250 response calls, 2,000+ unstable buildings, 300,000 tents, and 70,000 flooded tents are repeats, not new incidents.
English WAFA story with two deaths and Safa story with five deaths refer to the same newly identified Deir al-Balah collapse, not additional independently separate tragedies.
Political/government-formation stories and advocacy statements with no demonstrated new Gaza operational change excluded.
Older Rafah medical-evacuation reports, Gaza-unrelated prison/West Bank claims, and historical Reuters/AP search hits excluded.
Editorial opinions, non-attributed social media assertions and unsourced claims excluded.
known_gaps: WHO EMRO 502 and UNRWA 403 were also present in preceding watches. OCHA and WHO global remained accessible; these are continuing restrictions, not newly material coverage loss.
Safa and WAFA reported conflicting fatality/injury totals; independent humanitarian agency confirmation not located. Retain explicit source attribution and do not resolve by guessing.
Exact incident time unreported; search indexing delays and many stale hits limit completeness.
Primary Gaza production collector/dedupe database was not accessed or modified.
coverage_notes.assessment: One new Gaza-specific storm-related lethal shelter-collapse incident identified in the observation window; reported death and injury counts conflict. DEGRADED records continuing WHO regional/UNRWA direct-site restrictions, with useful alternative coverage retained.
